summary: Shelton, Ronaldo, Misri published; hockey final, Ganjam, Puri, SAFF held for pictures

editor_fail.why: The replacement main picture, now the homepage lead, is still a stand-in. It is a 2018 file photo of Puri speaking at a plastics recycling and waste management conference. The banner reading 'International Conference on Plastics Recycling & Waste Management, 28th September 2018' takes up most of the frame, Puri is a small figure at the left edge and four unrelated panellists fill the rest. It does not match a Rajya Sabha election story and looks lazy for the lead.
editor_fail.fix: Use a clear, recent, tightly cropped portrait of Hardeep Singh Puri (quick_photo.py 'Hardeep Singh Puri'), as hero.need asks, or a photo of him filing his nomination in Bhopal on October 31 with CM Mohan Yadav. No conference banners, maps or panels.
